# About
Akasha Yoga Academy offers internationally accredited online yoga teacher trainings
rooted in classical Hatha Yoga, Pranayama, Meditation, and Yin Yoga. All courses
are Yoga Alliance certified. Programs combine 200+ Bali studio videos with live
Zoom sessions and supportive global community.

# Key facts
- Founded: 2015
- Graduates: 1,100+ across 6 continents
- Rating: 4.93 / 5 from 359+ reviews
- Accreditation: Yoga Alliance (RYT-200, RYT-500, YACEP)
- Format: Online, self-paced with live Zoom sessions
- Pricing: US$299 – US$1,999
